text:
zara: Quick idea 12 lunch: pairing a 25m lunchtime crag session with a 20m rooftop yoga cooldown tomorrow? meet at 12:05, climb 25m, then rooftop yoga at 12:35.
leo: love that. run-through schedule sounds tight but doable. Ill bring a mini foam roller.
morgan: I can teach a 15m yoga flow focused on shoulders/hips. beginner-friendly.
kelly: snack vote: boxed smoothies, granola bites, or nothing? democrats of snacks speak now. :banana: :apple: :tada:
zara: boxed smoothies please. low-mess. also can someone bring an extra harness for demo?
leo: I have one spare harness. also FYI rooftop mat limit is 8 people.
morgan: reminder: bring a towel for yoga, shoes off on rooftop.
stretch-bot: Quick tip: 2-3 minutes of wrist mobility before climbing reduces strain. See pinned mobility routine.
calendar-bot: Event created Rooftop Yoga + Quick Crag 12:05-12:50 Link: https://calendar.redwood.work/event/2100209876
kelly: poll: whos in? react :one: = climb + yoga, :two: = yoga only, :three: = neither but cheerleaders welcome
leo: :one:
morgan: :one:
kelly: :two: (got a meeting at 12:20 but will pop up for yoga)
zara: ok tally: climb+yoga 2, yoga-only 1. looks good. 
leo: small logistical note 12 check the south gate code before leaving; sometimes its sticky.
morgan: can someone snap a quick route demo vid for folks who havent tried slab tech? 30s is enough.
zara: Ill film a 20s clip. also well name the rooftop flow Office Savasana if we get at least 4 participants.
kelly: challenge accepted. see you all noonish by kitchen stairs. :raised_hands:
